text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced meat, medium-brown with pinkish-red interior, moist with slight sheen, fibrous grain visible in thin slices, some browned edges and darker crust on outer surfaces, arranged in an overlapping pile in upper right of plate, about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, roughly 1.5 cm thick slices | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-brown cubes, firm-looking with matte, slightly glossy surface, uniform cut into roughly 2 cm blocks, some edges darker and browned, sitting in a cluster left of the sliced meat, moist but not flowing | 95
ITEM 3 | Mixed fresh green leaves, bright to dark green with pale stems, slightly wilted and glossy, spread in a loose mound across lower right of plate covering about 12 by 10 cm, with some leaf fragments extending toward the meat | 45
ITEM 4 | Chopped pecan halves and pieces, golden-brown with darker roasted edges, dry and crunchy-looking, scattered among the greens in the lower right, about 0.5 to 1.5 cm pieces | 12
ITEM 5 | Small smears of translucent, glossy liquid, pale brownish, thin film on plate rim near the meat and greens, barely visible, likely dressing or meat juice | 5
